name: Maison
inspiration: the workspace house style — derived from the Higgsfield creator-tutorial style (09), rebranded to the house yellow #FFD935. Yellow accent over three canvases (near-black navy, dark warm-amber dot-matrix, butter cream), frosted-glass panels floating in perspective beside the speaker, staged grey-to-jaune text reveals, LED boot cards, kinetic cream typography montages. Reference frames in references/ (from the Higgsfield source style).
summary: the workspace house style. Use as the default for his talking-head videos: tool tutorials, workflow walkthroughs, and tech-forward content where graphics should feel like the product UI escaped into the room.

palette.notes: Jaune maison #FFD935 is the ONLY saturated color (brand accent — see memory jaune-maison-ffd935). Three takeover canvases exactly: navy, warm-amber olive, cream. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Garet Black ALL CAPS, tracking -0.05em, is the display voice; Garet regular for body. Instrument Serif italic is the second (editorial) voice. JetBrains Mono for pills, tags, eyebrow sublabels. Fonts in fonts/, wired in tokens.css (17/08).

motion: TWO REGISTERS, never mixed (see DESIGN.md 'Les deux registres'). LONG 16:9 = SOFT: SNAP (text reveals + panel entrances, expo.out ~0.45s; pops back.out(1.9)) and DRIFT (glass panels float sine.inOut ~6s while alive; text never drifts); one card per 15-30s of speech; holds 4-7s. COURT 9:16 = DYNAMIQUE: permanent motion (typewriter, shimmer, counters — no dead frames), one visual event per 3-8s, one-word karaoke captions (~300ms/word), holds 2-3s max, cards maison.soc.* only. Shared signature: the grey-to-jaune flip, staged never simultaneous; dot-matrix shimmer resolves; glare sweep on media/UI card entrances.
transitions: Elements snap in and out (slide + fade, --dur-out); takeovers hard-cut against footage. Graphics persist across camera-angle cuts and re-anchor.

cards.notes: The match-cut bridge: a jaune prop flies across frame, the scene hard-swaps under it at center crossing. Cut hidden by the moving object.
Talking-head punch-in as jump cut: instant scale steps (1.00/1.07/1.14), then a hard cut back to rest. No easing, no blur.
Tilted frosted-glass pane whips across L-to-R, scene swaps at the covered midpoint. Same glass as tier2 panels, jaune leading edge.
Jaune-rimmed media panel slides in from frame-right (expo.out), drifts while alive, slides back out. The base scene never cuts, the panel IS the b-roll.
Olive LED-dot shutter resolves on with a jaune glow pulse, scene swaps behind, shutter dissolves. The chapter turn between sections.
Camera dives into an anchored glass panel until it becomes the next scene; scene A parallax-falls behind. One continuous zoom, cut invisible at full cover.
Camera whips left as one world: both scenes travel together, blur peaks mid-move, B lands with a 30px overshoot settle.
Rotational whip: -9deg + scale punch + blur out of A, cut at peak, B un-spins from +9deg to level. Rotation direction carries through the cut.
Crash-zoom to 1.55 with blur and a 1.5deg rotation kiss, cut at peak, B settles from 1.4 to rest.
B pushes A off-left; A retreats at 60% speed under a darkening shade (depth), B overshoots 26px and settles. Jaune hairline on the leading edge.
Four vertical slats of B drop in staggered 70ms apart (expo.out) with jaune leading edges; real B swaps under full cover, slats dissolve.
B irises open from a click point behind a jaune ring that leads the edge and dissolves. Clip-path driven.
Cinematic blink: bars crush closed, meet as a jaune hairline flash, swap behind closed lids, reopen on B. Heaviest move; 1-2 uses per video.
A 420px Inter Tight 900 word drives through as the wiper with a motion lean; swap under its center pass.
The speaker PIP grows to full-bleed and becomes the next scene; A dims and scales back behind. Inverse of zoom-through; use leaving screen-share sections.
Three-frame jaune-white pop; the cut lands inside the flash, B settles from a 1.06 micro-punch. For rapid montage runs.

cards.notes: mascotte pixel Claude (terracotta, antenne jaune) : chute+squash, coucou, clignements, rebond. Positionner via .mascot-pos au montage.

Le mouvement signature. C'est le redressement du lacet (--yaw-far -> --yaw-near) qui fait l'effet, pas le zoom : un scale() plat ne le reproduit pas. Ne jamais l'ease-out — le plan doit bouger encore à la coupe. Pousser --z-near vers 240px quand la carte n'a pas de chapitre.

La zone se decrit en --rx / --ry / --rw / --rh (% de l'ecran, largeur ET hauteur libres). Le filet se pose AVANT la plongee : on montre ou on va avant d'y aller. Complementaire de cx-ui-highlight, qui encercle sans bouger.

Le marqueur est un background-size anime : aucun reflow, la liste ne bouge pas d'un pixel. Un seul item allume a la fois. Remplacer BEATS par les timecodes des mots du transcript ; le balayage part 0.14s AVANT le mot pour etre pose quand il tombe. La bascule de couleur est une tween, pas une classe (GSAP n'execute pas ses callbacks au seek).

La carte-atelier importée de la grammaire Nick Saraev (13) : tout asset rapporté par insert-broll est montré avec une des 5 entrées (whip defaut, zoomin, zoomout, pan, pop=carte verre posée sur la scène) + une dérive continue jusqu'à la coupe. theme: navy | cream. Alterner les variantes. Voir PLAYBOOK.md loi 3.

Le geste d'annotation importé de Nick Saraev, au jaune le créateur : vraie capture plein cadre, floutée/assombrie partout sauf UNE zone nette cerclée d'un trait jaune 8px qui dessine son périmètre, puis zoom continu vers la zone. Zone via --rx/--ry/--rw/--rh (%). Sans label. 1-2 par reel max — pour LE chiffre, LE bouton.

Le geste central importé de Nathan Hodgson (12) : une app REDESSINÉE (jamais une capture) en carte den sur la moitié haute, qui joue sa séquence causale — la requête se tape (45ms/car), statut, lignes qui tombent, badges qui basculent au jaune, compteur+jauge linéaires. Une séquence par étape de workflow. Ne jamais couper avant la fin de l'exécution.
